test_cases.summary:
Verify Lock confirmation popup opens on clicking Lock icon
when the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Session – Popup Open

Scenario: Verify Lock confirmation popup opens on clicking Lock icon

Given the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
And a session status is Completed
When the user clicks the Lock icon
Then the Lock popup should open with Reason textbox and Submit/Cancel buttons
test_cases.acceptance:
The Lock popup should open with Reason textbox and Submit/Cancel buttons
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Lock icon.

test_cases.summary:
Verify submission is blocked if reason is empty
when Lock popup is opened
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Session – Reason Mandatory

Scenario: Verify submission is blocked if reason is empty

Given Lock popup is opened
When the user keeps Reason field empty
And clicks Submit
Then the system should block submission
And mandatory validation should be shown for Reason
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should block submission
The behavior should be validated when the user keeps Reason field empty.

test_cases.summary:
Verify session is locked when valid reason is entered
when Lock popup is opened
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Session – Lock Success with Valid Reason

Scenario: Verify session is locked when valid reason is entered

Given Lock popup is opened
When the user enters a valid reason (Ex:For testing lock)
And clicks Submit
Then the session should be locked successfully
And lock state should be applied in UI
test_cases.acceptance:
The session should be locked successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user enters a valid reason (Ex:For testing lock).

test_cases.summary:
Verify session is not locked when user cancels popup
when Lock popup is opened
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Session – Cancel Does Not Lock Session

Scenario: Verify session is not locked when user cancels popup

Given Lock popup is opened
When the user enters a reason
And clicks Cancel
Then the popup should close
And session should remain unlocked
test_cases.acceptance:
The popup should close
The behavior should be validated when the user enters a reason.

test_cases.summary:
Verify lock reason is stored and visible as tooltip after locking
when the session is locked using a reason
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Session – Reason Stored for Audit

Scenario: Verify lock reason is stored and visible as tooltip after locking

Given the session is locked using a reason
When the user hovers over lock indicator/icon in session list
Then the tooltip should show “Session is locked. Reason: <entered reason>”
test_cases.acceptance:
The tooltip should show "Session is locked. Reason: <entered reason>"
The behavior should be validated when the user hovers over lock indicator/icon in session list.

test_cases.summary:
Verify user can duplicate a locked session successfully
when a session is locked

The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to edit session using direct request/API call.

test_cases.summary:
Verify locked session cannot be edited via direct URL navigation
when the session is locked

The behavior should be validated when the user tries to open Edit Session page via direct URL.
